overall_notes: Eleven legs, all with 2+ books and morning price_ts aligned with the injury check; pricing and volume reasoning look consistent with the veto rules. I would not cut any leg on concrete rule violations. Main live risks are L1 (Maxey Q, early tip) and L6 (SAC back-to-back), but those are noted in the drafter copy rather than pricing or thesis errors.

votes.reasoning: Simons O1.5 ast is supported by 6/10 at 2+ assists, elevated minutes, and thin PHI guard depth with Maxey still questionable rather than ruled out after the 9:54 price snapshot. Five-book median devig and explicit matinee recheck limit LINE-MISMATCH and STALE-PRICE concerns for this morning draft. Key risk is the hard 2-assist ceiling in L10 if minutes do not stay high. Would cut only if Maxey is out and prices or on-ball redistribution materially change before lock.

Lillard O3.5 ast matches primary-creator usage with 7/10 at 4+ and a single zero-outlier game, and four books on a 3.5 pick'em assists line with per-book median pricing. Absence stack and optional Avdija sit are framed as creation upside, not an under-style role-expansion veto. Key risk is another low-assist night if pace or NYK defense stalls the half court. Would reconsider if Avdija plays full minutes and books move the line up without a matching form bump.

DJJ U1.5 ast is a explicit volume under with 9/10 at one or fewer assists and steady minutes, and long-term LAC outs are not flagged as recent role expansion in the last three games. Under side beyond -180 is paired with attempt-style justification, satisfying UNDER-ROLE-EXPANSION volume expectations. Competitive game risk is acknowledged and does not rely on blowout benching. Would cut only if a new wing injury suddenly pushes Jones into primary playmaking.

McDaniels O2.5 ast fits expanded role with MIN injuries and 9/10 at 3+ assists on heavy minutes. Five-book median pricing and no recent_miss on a standard 2.5 line avoid the structural cuts. Key risk is the 1-assist floor game in 39 minutes Nov 19 against NYK. Would flip to cut if Edwards or other creators return and minutes regress before tip.

Vassell O3.5 reb ties recent Harper and Harris absences to 32–36 minutes and 4–6 boards in the last three, with six of ten at 4+ overall. Four-book median and NO back-to-back opponent context support the over without blowout-only logic. Key risk is regression if Harris returns or pace stays low. Would reconsider on a sharp line move up without matching rebound volume.

LaVine O2.5 reb has strong L10 hit rate and depleted SAC frontcourt minutes narrative with three books still meeting the n_books>=2 bar. Pricing method is per-book median, not cross-book paired extremes. Key risk is SAC second night of a back-to-back after 39 minutes, which is workload not a veto error. Would cut on STALE-PRICE only if Tatum/White status changes prices without a recheck.

Hertl O1.5 SOG shows 9/10 at 2+ with stable TOI and PP usage, plus opponent D absence framed as shot-suppression relief. Four tight books around 60% fair avoid single-book and line-mismatch issues. Key risk is a single-SOG night in low-event game script. Would reconsider if DeMelo status changes or books steam down sharply.

Coyle O1.5 SOG is backed by 9/10 at 2+ shots and top-six/PP stability with Monahan out, against a thin TOR blue line. Four-book median at 1.5 SOG is appropriate for pick'em settlement. Key risk is road game pace below CBJ’s Nov 19 six-SOG spike. No under-style role-expansion or stale-price flag for this morning snapshot.

Finnie O1.5 SOG leverages Larkin IR minutes with 8/10 at 2+ and weakened NYI defensive availability. Five-book median satisfies pricing rules and recent_miss is null. Key risk is Pulock/Stanley playing limits the soft matchup edge. Would cut only if Larkin returns or Finnie’s TOI drops materially in late scratches.

Peterka O1.5 SOG has 7/10 at 2+ with Hagens IR keeping top-six volume, and five books near 60% on the 1.5 line. Recent TOI dip to 14:24 is flagged in the thesis, not ignored. Key risk is another sub-18-minute game with zero shots. Would reconsider if Hagens returns or books move without line adjustment.

Evangelista O1.5 SOG uses Mantha’s Nov 17 IR as shooting-role upside for an over, distinct from the skipped Hischier under on the same injury. Seven of ten at 2+ and five-book median pricing pass structural checks. Key risk is last-game one-SOG regression in 15–19 minute band. Would cut on UNDER-ROLE-EXPANSION logic only if this were an under; as an over the absence supports volume.
